featured_reviews.review_text:
We had purchased services from Livedecor in the month of May 2022 and had a very bad experience. Even before completing 1 year the dolpuri tiles are coming out. On checking the quotation for redoing the tiles work  we where shocked. His quotation was 30% less than the Live decor charged us.
Live decor carpentry work is of poor quality, every furniture has an issue.
The company had charged us with additional amount for floor protection, but we can actually see lines and cuts on the floor tiles.
High gloss Laminates are not glitering, they have used below average material but charged us with high end pricing.
Every furniture has fevicol stain marks.
Shoe rack dont have ventilation.
Laminates across the furniture are chipping off and there are cracks everywhere.
Security door's latch came out, upon checking came to know that Live decor has not fixed the 2 sides screw. I have to rechangethe entire Latch.
Wardrobe lock got cracked and Slider track has come out.
Every furniture has line and length issue. and has rising wedge formation and that accumulates lot of dust.
Wardrobe is not wall touch Live decor kept some space. and filled the space with POP and now it is coming out and dust getting accumulated in that space.
Laminates catch dust easily. Furniture corners are not rounded.
Will never recommend Live decor to anyone. Our brand new flat look five years older. Lot of false commitment before sale and did not complete even the basic expected standard of work!!!!!
